stories.title: Cleveland police seek public's help identifying suspects in armed Family Dollar robbery
stories.summary: Police say two suspects armed with a firearm robbed the store on St. Clair Avenue in the city's Forest Hills neighborhood on Nov. 4.

stories.title: Suspect connected to deadly baby shower shooting in Parma makes initial court appearance: Watch video as he faced a judge
stories.summary: The three people who died in the baby shower shooting were 17, 19 and 45 years old. Deangelo Townsend has been charged with murder. His bond was set at $1 million.

stories.title: Lock 3 Winterblast returns to Akron for 22nd season starting Friday: What to know about skating, holiday events and more
stories.summary: The festivities begin Nov. 27 with the Welcome Santa Parade, drone show and fireworks, followed by months of winter activities through Feb. 15.

stories.title: Cleveland Metroparks Zoo announces death of 15-year-old koala known as Nyoonbi
stories.summary: "We are grateful to the animal care and veterinary teams who cared for Nyoonbi and formed such a special bond with him."

stories.title: Situation contained, residents permitted to return home after 'major natural gas leak' in Sagamore Hills neighborhood
stories.summary: "AVOID THE AREA," police had declared on Facebook.

stories.title: Ohio senators consider eliminating data center sales tax exemption
stories.summary: Earlier this year, lawmakers tried to cut the tax break in half through Ohio House Bill 646. The measure, which makes several changes to data center policy in Ohio.

stories.title: 2 dead, several injured after head-on crash involving COTA buses in Columbus
stories.summary: The crash near Weinland Park prompted a major emergency response, with dozens of firefighters working to rescue passengers from the damaged buses.

stories.title: Crews respond to 'heavy fire' at 2-story Akron home; partial roof collapse reported
stories.summary: The Lake Street home was unoccupied at the time of the fire. Akron's Fire Investigation Unit was called in to investigate.

stories.title: Child struck and killed by vehicle in Akron on Saturday identified as 8-year-old boy from Alabama
stories.summary: The Summit County Medical Examiner’s Office confirmed the boy’s identity as 8-year-old Grayson Beach from Robertsdale, Alabama.

stories.title: Spinal cord stimulation now helps more people living with chronic pain: Cleveland Clinic specialist explains how it works
stories.summary: Spinal cord stimulation is no longer just a last resort after back surgery. A spine specialist explains who it may help, plus tips for traveling with back pain.

stories.title: Gas prices down 47 cents in Akron, 41 cents in Cleveland: Here’s what GasBuddy is saying about the drop
stories.summary: What's the last price you paid? GasBuddy says the average in Akron is now listed at $2.86 per gallon. The average in Cleveland dropped to $3.07.

stories.title: Police: Parma baby shower shooting leaves 3 dead, including unborn child's father, grandfather
stories.summary: Police say the unborn baby's 19-year-old father and 45-year-old maternal grandfather were among those found dead at the scene.
